hooks.text: 选择不同阴间使者，在妖怪浪潮中高速割草，突出穿透人群的直接清场快感
hooks.excerpt: Face endless waves of Yaoguai on a treacherous battlefield. Carve a whirlwind of destruction through the crowd and savor the simple, visceral joy of underworld envoys doing their jobs. Choose your champion from unique underworld envoy generals and dominate the battlefield.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 命运石、阴法术与纸扎道具可自由混搭，消耗阴间货币锻造每局不同的战斗流派
hooks.excerpt: Unleash unpredictable power by freely combining fate stones and yin spells . Use underworld currency to stock up on powerful paper crafts, forging countless synergies and combat styles. Master your unique build and discover that no two runs are ever the same.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 战斗之外还要处理喂妖怪、帮走失神仙和化解狐妖修行纠纷等荒诞阴间日常
hooks.excerpt: Your duties go beyond battle. Solve the underworld's daily chaos such as feed a hungry Yaoguai, help a misplaced god or untangle a fox spirit in his cultivation... A top-tier envoy masters both the pen and the blade. Ready to negotiate peace or clear the scene!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
